name: The World of AI: Legal Models directory page
title: The World of AI: Legal Models directory page
answer: The World of AI publishes a Legal Models directory page that lists the 1000 most-downloaded open legal models on the Hugging Face Hub, with licence, downloads, and release date, refreshed daily. Its most useful feature is that it points readers to a daily-updated, download-ranked index of open legal models, each linked to its own Hub page, while also noting the site's broader database covers state AI laws, a lawsuit tracker, a glossary, and other resources. The page is mainly a catalogue and promotional landing page, not an evaluation.

sections.body: The World of AI publishes this page. It is a directory or catalogue page for Legal Models, not a report or article. Its stated scope is the 1000 most-downloaded open legal models on the Hugging Face Hub, with licence, downloads, and release date, refreshed daily. The page states it was last verified on 2026-09-26 and that its source is the Hugging Face Hub public API, sorted by all-time downloads, with every model linking to its own Hub page. The same page also carries site search information, a citation line, and promotional material for books and consulting services.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page says it catalogues the 1000 most-downloaded open legal models on the Hugging Face Hub. Each listed model is meant to show licence, downloads, and release date, and the list is refreshed daily. The ranking is by all-time downloads, and the data comes from the Hugging Face Hub public API. Every model links to its own Hub page. The page was last verified on 2026-09-26. Beyond that catalogue, the text describes a site-wide search covering the full text of every published page, all built from the same database. That database is said to include state AI laws, the lawsuit tracker, the glossary, the tools directory, AI companies, the research library, the MCP server registry, compliance frameworks, sources, people, the calculators, and the weekly digests. The page gives a citation format for itself. It also promotes books by Stephen R. Jordan, including The Operating Discipline for AI Library series, and announces that SRJ Consulting & Services has published its first work of fiction on AI, The AI Lawyer, a novel, out 17 August 2026. It lists consulting service names and describes an atlas of artificial intelligence covering what the law says, who is suing whom, and what the words mean, with every page rebuilt daily from primary sources and carrying its last verified date, and free to read, cite, and query.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The source states that the catalogue covers the 1000 most-downloaded open legal models on the Hugging Face Hub, sorted by all-time downloads and refreshed daily. It states that the data source is the Hugging Face Hub public API and that the page was last verified on 2026-09-26. It states that The AI Lawyer novel is out 17 August 2026. It gives no model performance metrics, accuracy figures, or legal outcome numbers.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in Legal can use this page as a pointer to a daily-updated, download-ranked list of open legal models on Hugging Face, with licence, download, and release-date fields and links to each model page. That helps track which open legal-tuned models are attracting downloads and what licences they carry. The page also signals that the same site's search covers state AI laws, a lawsuit tracker, a glossary, and other legal AI resources, so it can serve as an entry point to broader legal AI monitoring. It does not evaluate the models or explain how they perform on legal tasks.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Legal

sections.body: The page is a landing page with little explanatory substance. It does not cover closed or proprietary legal AI models, does not explain how a legal model is defined, and gives no benchmarks, accuracy results, or methodology beyond the Hugging Face Hub public API and all-time download sorting. It is partly commercial, promoting books by Stephen R. Jordan and SRJ Consulting & Services, including The AI Lawyer novel. It is dated by its last verified date of 2026-09-26 and is refreshed daily, but the harvested text is a snapshot. It is also limited to the 1000 most-downloaded open models on one hub.
